alternatives: One pass supplying the whole available paper text to the same reader and answer prompt, within an equalized context budget.
Use iterative search and inspection of selected passages, with explicit evidence coverage checks and a fallback to broader paper inspection on uncertain or multi-hop cases.
brief.applicability: On the same 40 questions, compare full-paper input with bounded iterative search/read at equal model and output limits. Independently mark required evidence spans, supported-answer quality, missed-evidence cases, input tokens, latency, and execution errors.
constraints: No paid model APIs, GPU, or training in this pilot.
Development results are provisional; do not represent independent human support review.
brief.expected_signal: Adopt selected-passage reading if independently reviewed supported-answer passes are no lower than full-paper, missed required evidence increases by at most 1/40, and median input tokens fall by at least 25%. Treat small sample uncertainty explicitly.
brief.hypothesis: Use iterative search and inspection of selected passages, with explicit evidence coverage checks and a fallback to broader paper inspection on uncertain or multi-hop cases.
limitations: This draft is a decision aid; it has not been executed or independently validated.

observations.text: Qwen3-8B code-execution paper reader has 35 replay-verified trajectories. On 40 development questions, v5 SFT changed recorded execution-error episodes from 22 to 1; provisional supported-answer passes on 20 answerable cases stayed at 3 for base and v5.

brief.question: For paper QA, whole long paper or iterative selected-passage search/inspection?
unknowns: The QASPER discourse study tested different models and a structured retriever; selected passages can omit global or multi-hop context. The project question set is a development comparison, not a held-out leaderboard.
